name: Essential Real Estate
author: g5theme

sections.description:
Main Site | Docs | Add-ons | Premium Theme

There are full features needed for a real estate website, easy to customize and overwrite templates. Allow to manage property listings and submit property via back-end and front-end. Supported global payment, build market, agent management,…etc.
FREE plugins but already all PREMIUM FEATURES.

Demo with premium theme

  • Click Create Demo to create temporary website.

You can View demo or buy Homeid WP theme.
You can View demo or buy Beyot WP theme.
You can View demo or buy Benaa WP theme.

Sample Data Demo

  • Download xml file: sample-data.xml
  • Download zip file: sample-data.zip

Add-ons

  • ERE Download – Addons Free
  • ERE Colors – Addons Free
  • ERE Recently Viewed – Addons Free
  • ERE Similar Properties – Addons Free

Video how to

Features

  • Already define pages for Real Estate website like: Search Page, Listing Properties, Listing Agent, Agency, Payment, Profile,…
  • Submit property via Back-End and Front-End
  • Manage property listings via Back-End and Front-End
  • Can add custom fields for property
  • Easy to customize
  • Flexible Search
  • Favorite Properties
  • Saved Searches Properties
  • Compare Properties
  • Print Properties
  • Nearby Place
  • Membership Packages
  • Management invoices, User Profiles,…
  • Listing Expiration Date
  • Paid Submission Type: Free, Pay per Package, Pay per Listing
  • Payment Method: Paypal, Stripe, Wire Transfer
  • Email Listing Alerts
  • Featured Listings
  • Related Listing
  • Google Suggestions, Geo Location Search, Map Directions
  • Supported Google Captcha
  • Social Login, Social Share
  • Multiple Listing Layouts
  • Fully Responsive
  • Gallery, Video, 360 Virtual Tour, …
  • Contact Agent
  • Private Note
  • Compatible With Visual Composer plugin
  • Compatible With WPML plugin
sections.installation:
Do follow to install plugins:

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to menu Essential Real Estate -> Real Estate Options screen to configure the plugin

5.3.6

  • Security: Fix incomplete patch for arbitrary email sending in contact agent form – the recipient is now resolved server-side from the property, agent or agency (CVE-2026-90964 bypass, reported by Aabideen Bangash via WPScan)
  • Security: Contact messages for properties using “Other contact” by non-privileged authors are sent to the author’s account email. To keep sending to the “Other contact” email, use the filter ere_trust_property_other_contact_mail
  • Security: Changing the account email from the front-end profile now requires confirmation from the new address
  • Security: When “Enable password” is on, new accounts must be activated from the link sent to their email before they can log in. Administrators can activate accounts manually from Users list. Accounts never activated within 48 hours are removed when someone registers the same username or email
  • Security: Fix non-admin users overwriting any agent’s details from the wp-admin profile page
  • Security: Rate limit contact form submissions (10 per 10 minutes per visitor IP and recipient, filter: ere_contact_agent_rate_limit)
  • Note: Themes overriding global/contact-form.php or single-property/contact-agent.php must replace the target_email hidden field with contact_type and contact_id
  • Note: Please clear your page cache after updating so contact forms use the new fields
